description: Publishes a verifier's current conformance grade from the public registry (conformance.json) as a permanent, signed ledger entry, labeled 'certified as of this measurement'. It records the registry's existing measurement and cannot change it. Only works for a verifier currently listed as certified. Docs: https://api.babyblueviper.com/conformance

name.description: The verifier's exact name as listed on GET /conformance.json (must currently show certified:true).

note.description: Optional short context for the ledger entry.

name: conformance_certify
